菜还没上，手机先震了。

顾承安低头瞥了一眼，来自天珠APP信息采集完毕的提示。

他没有切换到智能眼镜进行查看。

原因很朴素。

费电。

这副眼镜的续航本来就不算长，在上面进行信息查看，电量掉得跟漏水似的。

反正手机上看记忆视频效果一模一样，没必要为了省下拿手机的力气而浪费生产力。

顾承安从口袋里摸出蓝牙耳机，连上手机，点开天珠APP。

开始查看起信息来。

【姓名：吴灿锋，男，52岁。】

【国籍：东大。】

【身份证号：440304……7728。】

【手机号：139……8888。】

【当前职业：光明实业集团董事长/杀人犯/黑老大/绑架/……】

当前职业那一栏，一长串的头衔格外扎眼，这还是第一次遇见。

天珠给出的职业标签从来不说废话，它不会因为你名片上印着“企业家”就给你贴企业家的标签，它只认事实。

信息卡片下方，是一长串的记忆视频。

顾承安点开第一段。

时间标注显示是二十三年前。

一处荒凉的建筑工地，夜间，没有灯光，只有远处公路上偶尔驶过的车辆大灯扫过来，在泥地上照出一道道昏暗的光。

吴灿锋站在一个刚挖好的地基坑边上，身后跟着两个人。

坑里躺着一个男人，手脚被捆着，嘴里塞着布条，眼睛瞪得老大，拼命扭动身体。

吴灿锋蹲下来，拍了拍那人的脸，声音不大，言语间甚至很有耐心：“张哥，不是我不给你机会，那块地皮的事我跟你谈了三次了，你非要跟我抢！你怎么能跟我抢呢？”

捆着的男人发出呜呜的声音，显然在求饶。

吴灿锋站起身，回头对身后的人摆了摆手。

混凝土搅拌车的发动机轰地响了起来。

灰白色的水泥浆从出料口倾泻而下，缓缓灌入地基坑。

画面里，捆着的男人开始剧烈挣扎，但手脚被绑得死死的，根本动弹不得，水泥浆淹过他的腿，他的腰，他的胸口。

最后，淹过他的脸。

搅拌车的轰鸣声持续了大约三分钟。

坑被填平了。

吴灿锋转过身，掸了掸袖子上沾到的一点灰，对旁边的人说：“明天让工人正常施工，这一段浇厚点。”

语气就像在交代一件再普通不过的工地管理事务。

顾承安的表情没有变化，但握着手机的手指收紧了一点。

Before the food was served, my phone buzzed.

Gu Chengan lowered his head and glanced at the notification from Tianzhu APP that the information collection was completed.

He didn't switch to smart glasses to see.

The reason is simple.

Waste electricity.

The battery life of this pair of glasses is not long to begin with, but when I checked information on them, the battery dropped as if water was leaking.

Anyway, the effect of watching the memory video on the mobile phone is exactly the same. There is no need to waste productivity just to save the effort of holding the mobile phone.

Gu Chengan took out the Bluetooth headset from his pocket, connected it to his phone, and clicked on the Dzi Bead APP.

Start checking the information.

[Name: Wu Canfeng, male, 52 years old.】

[Nationality: Dongda.】

[ID number: 440304...7728.】

[Mobile phone number: 139...8888.】

[Current occupation: Chairman of Guangming Industrial Group/murderer/gangster/kidnapping/...]

In the current occupation column, a long list of titles is particularly eye-catching. This is the first time I have seen it.

The professional labels given by Tianzhu never talk nonsense. It will not label you an entrepreneur just because "entrepreneur" is printed on your business card. It only recognizes the facts.

Below the information card is a long list of memory videos.

Gu Chengan clicked on the first paragraph.

The time stamp shows it was twenty-three years ago.

There is a desolate construction site. At night, there are no lights. Only the headlights of the occasional passing vehicles on the distant road sweep over, illuminating the muddy ground with streaks of dim light.

Wu Canfeng stood beside a newly dug foundation pit, followed by two people.

There was a man lying in the pit, his hands and feet bound, a piece of cloth stuffed in his mouth, his eyes wide open, and he was twisting his body desperately.

Wu Canfeng knelt down and patted the man's face. His voice was not loud, and he was even very patient in his words: "Brother Zhang, it's not that I won't give you a chance. I've talked to you about that piece of land three times, and you insist on grabbing it from me! How can you grab it from me?"

The tied man whimpered, obviously begging for mercy.

Wu Canfeng stood up, turned around and waved to the person behind him.

The engine of the concrete mixer truck roared.

Gray-white cement slurry pours down from the discharge port and is slowly poured into the foundation pit.

In the picture, the tied man began to struggle violently, but his hands and feet were tied tightly and he could not move at all. The cement slurry flooded his legs, his waist, and his chest.

Finally, it flooded his face.

The roar of the mixer truck lasted for about three minutes.

The hole has been filled.

Wu Canfeng turned around, dusted off a little dust on his sleeves, and said to the person next to him: "Let the workers work normally tomorrow, and pour this section thicker."

The tone was like explaining an ordinary construction site management matter.

Gu Chengan's expression did not change, but the fingers holding the phone tightened a little.
